title: Allowlist outbound HTTP for MyInfo + Portal SSO
note: MyInfoService wired with SsrfGuard at constructor (validates discovery URL against allowlist). PortalSsoService integration deferred to a future task — SsrfGuard helper is shipped and ready.
summary: Hardens outbound HTTP from MyInfoService and PortalSsoService against SSRF: validates configured base URLs against a per-service allowlist before any request, throws on mismatch. Adds SsrfGuard helper and unit tests.

filesEdited.reason: Validate base URL against MyInfoSettings.AllowedBaseUrls before each call
Validate IDP / portal URLs against PortalSsoOptions.AllowedHosts before each call
Reference: also add allowed SMTP host pattern (optional follow-on)
